jobs_results.title: Localization Project Manager (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Africa, EMEA

CoachHub is on a mission to democratise coaching for all career levels worldwide. We need an amazing team to achieve this, so we’re bringing together kind, smart and highly-skilled people from all corners of the globe.

If you'd like to shape the success story of a fast-growing, award-winning company and the leading global digital coaching platform - get in touch!

Your mission

We are looking for an accomplished and motivated localization project manager to oversee the localization of our platforms and content for different markets (global).

Responsibilities will include coordinating translation projects, managing budgets, ensuring cultural sensitivity, maintaining project timelines, sorting out translation queries while collaborating with involved stakeholders, recruiting new localization vendors as needed, and invoicing.

You will be responsible for
• Project Management: Manage localization projects while... collaborating with all stakeholders involved, ensuring proper execution of our localization strategy and processes
• Vendor Management: Recruit, onboard, and manage relationships with localization vendors, ensuring high-quality and cost-effective services
• Content Localisation: Oversee the localization of documentation, marketing materials, customer-facing email, images and other content to meet the linguistic and cultural needs of our global markets
• Working closely with content writers, marketing, product team and developers, and other stakeholders to ensure source content is culturally sensitive and fit and suitable for localization
• Conducting quality assurance checks to maintain consistency and accuracy of localized content
• Tracking project progress, identify risks, and implement solutions to mitigate potential issues
• Staying up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in localization to drive continuous improvement

Your profile

Essential
• Strong communication skills, project management, proactiveness, solution-oriented, in-depth knowledge of localization tools, technologies, and industry best practices
• Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, or a related field is highly preferred
• 2+ years of proven experience as a Localisation Project Manager or similar role in a technology-driven and fast-paced environment

Desirable
• Content management experience
• Experience with web based CAT tools
• Experienced working with “Lokalise”
• Experience working in localization for startups
• First experience working with digital assets, such as video and audio
• Experience maintaining glossaries and style guides

Why us?
• Our fun team with lots of good talks and a caring atmosphere
• The opportunity to join a leading german start-up company (ranked as Linkedin Top Start-Ups 2023)
• A lot of room for your impact
• Long-term and very personal relationships with employees and customers
• Valuable insights and contacts in the L&D World
• A steep learning curve
• Your commitment has a direct impact on the business
• Your own personal business coach
• Diverse learning and training opportunities
• A remote-first workplace with a very central office in Berlin and co-working spaces in a lot of european countries and other german cities

The location of the position is not necessarily Berlin. You can be located (almost) anywhere in the Central European Time Zone.

-----

About CoachHub

CoachHub is the leading global talent development platform that enables organizations to create a personalized, measurable and scalable coaching program for the entire workforce, regardless of department and seniority level. By doing so, organizations are able to reap a multitude of benefits, including increased employee engagement, higher levels of productivity, improved job performance and increased retention.

CoachHub’s global pool of coaches is comprised of over 3,000 certified business coaches in 70 countries across six continents with coaching sessions available in over 60 languages, to serve more than 500 clients.

Our programs are based on advanced R&D from our Coaching Lab. CoachHub is backed by leading tech investors, including Draper Esprit, Holtzbrinck Ventures, Partech, RTP Global, Signals Venture Capital, Sofina, Softbank and Speedinvest.

As of 2022, CoachHub is a certified Carbon Neutral Company. Find out more about CoachHub’s dedication to positive impact at www.coachhub.com/esg.

This offer from "CoachHub" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 83.25% flex score

jobs_results.title: Junior Project Manager - German & English
jobs_results.description:
Adam digitizes the painting industry!

Adam is a fast-growing Czech startup with a mission to provide affordable and straightforward construction and renovation services. We are a team led by the founders who previously helped build one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in Europe. Adam is already active in more than 10 European countries! Our vision is to expand to more than 10 cities within Germany within the next year, add more trades and become the next European unicorn. Do you want to be part of it?

We are looking for an analytical and solution-oriented Junior Project Manager (m/f/d) to join our team. You'll get the chance to experience what it's like to build an entire market from A to Z - you'll be responsible for marketing, legal and recruitment alongside the day-to-day running of the business. If you aspire to one day run your own business or manage a large department, Adam is the place for you.

We are a small team, led by two founders. Our founders... previously built a team of over 100 people at Bolt, one of Europe's largest and fastest growing tech companies. We are more than willing to share our experience with you! In return, we expect an energetic demeanor, hard work and a willingness to continuously learn.

Your work includes:
• You help to build the team in Madrid!
• You support all of Adam's business processes
• You help us to react quickly to market trends - we need to move with the trends and be able to process an ever-growing number of orders quickly
• Development and implementation of new expansion strategies within Germany and Austria
• Communication with customers and partners
• Continuous improvement of the product according to Adam's value proposition

Who we are looking for:
• Excellent written and spoken German and English (Full Professional Proficiency). Other languages are an advantage but not a must
• Excellent communication skills
• A data-driven analytical mindset
• A hustler who doesn't stop giving it their all after 20 obstacles a day
• Degree and no more than 2 years of work experience (relevant experience is a plus but not a must)

Why you'll love it here:
• You help to build up the office in Madrid according to your ideas
• You are one of the key people in the most important market in Europe
• You have the opportunity to build a project that grows by ten percent every month! Including global ambition and the chance to experience how an international start-up works
• You will work directly with the founders and have weekly meetings for direct exchange
• You have the opportunity to greatly improve your language skills - your daily work takes place in German and English
• No corporate dress code, we want to have fun at work and expect the same from you :)
• You will work with a young, international and super talented team in Madrid and Prague
• Frequent visits to the headquarters in Prague
• One week a year with all teams from all countries in Prague
• Daily activities (volleyball, city rally and much more)
• Daily exchange with all teams and joint strategy development
• Cozy evenings in bars, restaurants and closing party
• Attractive remuneration

Here you can see our team on Instagram: @team_of_adam

Have we piqued your interest? Get in touch now with your resume

jobs_results.title: Career Opportunities: Sr. Project Manager (39835)
jobs_results.description:
At Cameco we understand the value of a diverse workforce and we embrace, encourage and support workplace inclusion and diversity. New ideas, perspectives, experiences, and expertise make Cameco stronger. We are committed to building a diverse workforce reflective of the communities we operate in. Our vision is to create a culture where inclusion is the goal, and a diverse and representative workforce is our measure of success. Cameco is committed to providing an inclusive selection process, free from systemic barriers. support employment equity and encourage all members of underrepresented groups (i.e., women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of racialized groups/visible minorities) to voluntarily disclose. Cameco welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply.

About Us

Cameco is one of the largest global providers of the uranium fuel needed to energize a clean-air world. Utilities around the world rely on our nuclear fuel... products to generate safe, reliable, emissions-free nuclear power. Cameco’s corporate office is based in Saskatoon. We have mining operations and projects in northern Saskatchewan, Kazakhstan, the United States and Australia. We are also a leading supplier of uranium refining, conversion, and fuel manufacturing services from our operations in Ontario.

The Role

As a member of the technical services team, you will report to the Director, Development in the Saskatoon office. You will be responsible for leadership and quality execution of Cameco projects to ensure company goals and business objectives are achieved.

In this role, you will:
• Directly manage and oversee the successful execution of complex studies / projects of elevated strategic importance to ensure safety, quality, timeliness and profitability
• Develop and maintain relationships with subject matter experts and ensure appropriate utilization to bring value and innovation to studies
• Develop and maintain collaborative working relationships with management, operations, team members, and other key stakeholders
• Ensure that study and project risks are adequately addressed and communicated to the leadership team.

Required:
• A minimum of 10 years of combined work experience in progressive project management roles in a manufacturing, mining, or industrial setting
• Diploma or bachelor’s degree in a related field
• Equivalent combination of education and work experience will be considered
• Ability to think creatively, facilitate solutions, and achieve results
• thrive in a in dynamic environment, build trust, and maintain positive relationships with a wide variety of personnel

Recommended:
• PMP, trade certification, and/or professional engineering designation, or the ability to obtain the relevant certification
• Experience in executing all stages of the project lifecycle (i.e. initiation, planning and estimating, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, monitoring & controlling, etc.) to deliver brownfield industrial projects
• Experience working in operations at an industrial facility
• Experience with modern digital project tools and LEAN methodologies

Cameco is proud to offer a competitive total reward package which includes:
• Competitive compensation program with base and variable pay
• Flexible health, drug, dental, and vision plan with a health spending and personal spending account
• Fixed benefits including employee and dependant life, AD&D, disability benefits and paid vacation leave
• Employee & Family Assistance Programs
• RRSP and RPP matching program
• Relocation costs

Cameco is an employment equity employer and aims to achieve gender parity, and as such, preference will be given to qualified members of equity groups. We are strengthened by the diverse backgrounds of experiences and encourage applicants with various levels of expertise to apply, as equivalent combination of education and work experience are considered.

You will have the opportunity to work remote in this position. However, there may be the need for intermittent meetings in the Saskatoon office/travel to site. The details of this flex work arrangement will be discussed with you in the recruitment process.

Posted: April 11, 2024

Posting end date: April 25, 2024
Salary Range: $141,520 - $176,900

The physical and psychological safety of our employee’s is a top priority at Cameco. We invite candidates to voluntarily disclose accommodation requirements, if contacted in relation to a job opportunity. Information received will be addressed confidentially and Cameco’s Workplace Inclusion and Accommodation Program document is available upon request. Successful candidates for all positions that will work at Safety Sensitive Sites or Safety Sensitive Positions must take and pass a Substance Test, which includes marijuana, as a condition of employment. Marijuana remains in a user’s system for about 30 days, so applicants who recently used marijuana recreationally should not expect to pass a substance test.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Project Commissioning Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Commissioning Manager in Barcelona we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your testing & commissioning expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and proactive teammates.

You'll plan and manage all Test & Commissioning activities for the project in support to the Project Manager ensuring application of the project’s strategy (including QCD commitment) and compliance with métier strategy, policies, standards, local regulations and professional standards. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely... with teams across the business (project management, engineering) and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of managing the T&C team, but also collaborating with the V&V manager to define the V&V strategy to be applied in lab and on field.

We’ll look to you for:
• Responsible of the QCD commitment of the T&C Work Package
• Pro-actively manages the internal interfaces with Project Engineering, Industrial and Warranty, and the external interfaces with Partners, third parties and Customers.
• Deploys T&C process on the field and make sure it is applied by the T&C team within the project
• Pro-actively manages internal interfaces with project engineering, installation and external technical interfaces with Partners, Third Parties and Customers for T&C activities
• Delivers T&C plans, procedures, method statements and coordinates staffing and training of the T&C team.
• Prepares and manages Test & Commissioning works on field – Material and tools, documentation, people, access, logistics…
• Ensures the EHS compliance (Zero deviation), reports and anticipates issues
• Manages the T&C team:
• Ensures EHS on field with guidance and support from the Project team member in charge of Project EHS coordination
• Trains and supports people in T&C activities
• Participates to Subsystem Leader, Engineer and Technician assessment of competency
• Manages the tools and organize accurate calibration
• Anticipates issues and reports / alerts on a regular basis to the RC TCM and to the PM on progress, issues and risks on the project (EHS, T&C work, System delivery…)
• Ensures that all design related issues are correctly reported in the adequate tools, including the defect description and associated test context
• Monitors/manages QCD performance delivery (including EHS and Railway safety) of the work package T&C as per customer and solution / system requirements
• Issues the REX on T&C activities, and propose update / improvement of the T&C way of working / process / tools and the T&C Reference Library to optimize T&C performance

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• Master's degree in engineering (preferably electronics or embedded systems) or equivalent experience.
• Good knowledge of English language (read, written, spoken). Any other additional language is an asset
• More than 5 years of experience in T&C or V&V activities for signaling projects
• Experience of management by Quality, Cost and Delivery objectives
• Deep knowledge of multiple subsystems + system global view
• Interface with customer or partners and internally V&V, Design, Installation stakeholders
• Experience managing projetcs from T&C point of view
• Experience managing resoruces in projects of T&C
• Desirable: Previous team management experiences, Knowledge of ALSTOM rules and processes; and Quality, EHS and Railway safety knowledge
• Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills to fulfil the role of interface manager toward both customers and partners
• Able to manage multiple teams in parallel
• Quality-focused, rigorous, team-player
• Flexibility and mobility, available for short or long mission in different locations and countries
• Available to work on field also for night shifts
• Resilience, with an analytic way of thinking in order to solve complex system failures
• Customer satisfaction and results orientated
• Ability to use new technologies and tools
• Driving license

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our cooperative working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Alstom is the leading company in the mobility sector, solving the most interesting challenges for tomorrow’s mobility. That’s why we value inquisitive and innovative people who are passionate about working together to reinvent mobility, making it smarter and more sustainable. Day after day, we are building an agile, inclusive and responsible culture, where a diverse group of people are offered opportunities to learn, grow and advance in their careers, with options across functions and geographic locations. Are you ready to join a truly international community of great people on a challenging journey with a tangible impact and purpose?

Equal opportunity statement:

Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all our employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local law.

Job Type:​Experienced​

jobs_results.title: Sr Project Manager - EMEA
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA, India

Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

Essential Functions
• Diligent on-boarding of new implementation, upgrade or product tuning projects.
• Ensure scope of package purchased meets customer expectations.
• Drive all projects to deliver on-time, within scope and within budget, highlighting deviations to stakeholders.
• Work with Resource Manager to obtain Engineer allocation then manage scheduling.
• Develop detailed project plans to monitor... and track progress.
• Manage change to scope, schedule and costs.
• Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques.
• Perform risk management to minimize project risks.
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
• Build and grow relationships with both Technical staff and Sr. Management from the customer team.
• Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams in Forcepoint to communicate product enhancement requests identified during deployment activities.
• Conducts weekly calls with each project team during active project phases to understand deployment status, risk and drive progress.
• Own, drive and track deployment team escalations with Product Management, Engineering and Tech Support.
• Accountability for Project Processes, enabling effective PS department management and automated communication to other departments.
• Contribute to deployment lessons learned.
• Stay current on IT Security industry news and Forcepoint products.
• Shift slide to Europe or Middle East region hours as needs arise.
• Perform other duties, as assigned.

Education and Experience
• Experience working with a range of customer sizes, from a few hundred to 100k users.
• Minimum of 5 years project management experience.
• Experience managing multiple projects in parallel, with various levels of PM engagement.
• Strong personal drive for ensuring customer success with a proactive focus.
• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills including attention to detail, accountability, and multitasking.
• Ability to work on multiple projects in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines with a can-do attitude.
• Ability to understand technical issues at a high level, to communicate in a meaningful way internally and to executive level management.
• Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at the executive level with internal and customer stakeholders.
• Must be a team player and build good working relationships across all functions.
• Advanced Office tools experience such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Planner, OneNote, MS Teams and Visio.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience.

Education and Experience - Preference for:
• Experience working in PS, IT Security or the IT Industry in general, managing new product implementations.
• Background in a dynamic, problem solving, customer service environment.
• Proficient with MS Project.
• Experience with Salesforce, Certinia PSA and familiar with billing and revenue recognition.
• PMP or PRINCE2 qualified.

Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.

The policy of Forcepoint is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Forcepoint is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to recruiting@forcepoint.com.

Applicants must have the right to work in the location to which you have applied.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
SEBN ES- Spain, multinacional en expansión dedicada al diseño y fabricación de mazos de cableado eléctrico para la industria de automoción busca para su centro en Martorell:

Puesto a cubrir: Project Manager

Funciones:
• Gestión de proyectos (planificación, ejecución, control y elaboración de informes) para uno o varios proyectos de vehículos de acuerdo con los fundamentos de gestión de proyectos.
• Definición del alcance y negociación de los mismos.
• Reporte de la evolución de los proyectos y viabilidad económica de los mismos.
• Supervisión de la ejecución de los proyectos para cumplir con los plazos, coste y calidad.
• Idear soluciones para las problemáticas de los proyectos.
• Dirigir, gestionar y coordinar equipos multidisciplinares.
• Reportar a otras plantas y ser el enlace entre éstas y la sede central.
• Desarrollar mejoras de procesos y normas en la gestión de proyectos.

Requisitos mínimos:
• Formación universitaria: Grado en Ingeniería o Grado en Economía.
• Experiencia... mínima en gestión de proyectos: de 3 a 5 años en sector industrial.
• Nivel alto de inglés.
• Competencias personales: liderazgo de proyectos, organización y planificación y capacidad de comunicación.

Requisitos valorables:
• Certificación MS Project.
• Alemán.
• Conocimientos en metodologías ágiles (SCRUM etc.).

Ofrecemos:
• Oportunidad de desarrollar una carrera profesional en entorno multinacional en crecimiento.
• Autonomía, flexibilidad y desarrollo profesional.
• Formación continuada y actualizada

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
MEP Project Manager - Data Centres - Malaga, Spain

We are currently partnering with a leading global consulting and engineering company that are looking for experienced data centre professionals to join their team. Our client is working with many major developers in the data centre space and require a MEP Project Managerfor their Spanish location.

Our client offers strategic, tactical, and operational advice to a variety of entities, including colocation data centres, internet service providers, and telecom companies. Their team is composed of experts in diverse fields such as electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, construction, civil engineering, structure, building, architecture, fire safety, control engineering, and security technology.

Responsibilities:
• Managing and leading large-scale projects in a multi stakeholder environment throughout a complete project life cycle, supporting our customers multinational clients to make the best value decisions
• Developing... leading and managing the team during project development and delivery
• Initiating projects together with clients, coordinating stakeholder input, analyse and appraise production solutions, prepare project briefs & business cases and gain the necessary approvals within the client’s organisation
• Be in charge of all project controls: e.g. planning, cost control, project administration and contract management
• Operating in an international context (anticipate short, medium and long-term travel)
• Leads projects with short lead times
• Our clients projects are in Europe & Africa, so coordinating and working with people and subcontractors of the local culture is a must
• Monitor project progress, identify potential risks or issues, and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful project completion
• Coordinate project resources, including internal team members, external vendors, and subcontractors, to ensure seamless project execution

Requirements:
• A background from a Technical University (civil, mechanical, electrical)
• Over 6 years of experience in the management of multidisciplinary design and engineering and construction projects, preferably in the data centres or other relevant sectors
• Affinity with digital and automated design and engineering process (BIM360, CDE)
• Excellent knowledge of the English language (and language local to office location)
• Previous employment by a design and engineering company would be an advantage

If this role is of interest to you, please apply now!
